context: Filed 2026-11-20 from the adversarial review of the scale-factor and TPC-DI remediation work (PRs #4298-#4385 and benchbox-site #178-#210).
description:
## Problem
#4381 (59ad7aa1f6) is byte-for-byte the output of refresh run 44527917625. It loosens the gate by about 10%: the reference calibration fell from 1.4275 to 1.3435 (about 6.9% more allowance per test) and 2,123 new test ids (191.7 s) moved into the baseline; the median ratio on 22 recent runs went from 1.199 to 1.087, and #4335's run from 1.302 to 1.163. One source run is from #4363, which merged into release/0.5.x. The commit was re-authored under the owner's identity; the tree is identical (d9d849d3).

## Change
Keep, or dispatch a fresh refresh.

## Decision gates
Blocked until the owner chooses. Dispatching the workflow is a hosted write.

## Verification rubric
Pass: the choice is recorded; if refreshed, the new pull request and its merge are linked.

## Guardrails
- Any limit, default, threshold or label text is shown to the owner before it is committed.
- The implementer never resolves review threads on its own pull request; the reviewer or the owner does.
- No polling loop around `make pr-arm`, no `--no-verify`, and no stand-in review unless the owner names the PR and head unprompted.
- Heavy work runs only through `make heavy-run` or a lock-taking entry point.
- Status reports state only what merged and what was verified, with the evidence.
